name: log
purpose: Queries and streams the macOS unified system log database.
explanation: Reads historical OS kernel, power, sleep/wake, network, and application events stored in the macOS unified log database.

parameters.description: Queries past log entries stored on disk.
Limits results to a recent window such as `30m`, `1h`, or `1d`.
Filters events by process or message text.

expectedOutput: (Writes the last 1 hour of timestamped macOS system log entries into `mylog.txt`)
whenToUse: When investigating overnight battery drain, sleep/wake events, or daemon errors on macOS (Worksheet 12a).
commonMistakes: Running `log show` without `--last`—dumping days of logs can produce gigabytes of output.
explanationOfOutput: Streams formatted timestamp, thread/process, subsystem, and message columns to stdout.
commonErrors: `zsh: command not found: log` on Linux (use `/var/log/` or `journalctl` instead)
